properties.description: Built 2026-10-17 in reflow2-core's inference module (PR #763). A node an Inference concludes holds when one of its steps holds and is otherwise unknown ("unsupported: …"); only an objection that holds refutes it. The change walk counts a lost node as unsupported (or failing where it already fails), reads each step weakened, unsupported, broken (a premise really fails) or unknown, carries on past a conclusion that held and no longer does, and says of each claim `conclusion_reads`: still_supported (with `still_supported_by`, the other lines), unsupported or refuted.
properties.name: A claim that loses its support reads unsupported, never false, and the what-if says whether each claim is still supported, unsupported or refuted
